digest.component_or_area: LLM framework / Pydantic AI provider integration
propositions: Pydantic AI 1.107+ warns that the bare `openai:` prefix will change from Chat Completions to Responses semantics in v2, creating ambiguity and silent wire contract breakage on upgrade.
Rebar infers and emits the ambiguous `openai:` qualifier in anthropic_model.py and model_classes.py for primary, explicit, and fallback OpenAI targets, triggering the deprecation warning at runtime.

The ProviderSession custom-endpoint builder (cfg.base_url) and per-candidate endpoint-override guard only recognize the legacy `openai` provider name, causing endpoint routing to regress if the qualifier alone is changed to `openai-chat:`.

The repair normalizes all rebar-owned and legacy `openai:` model construction to the explicit `openai-chat:` qualifier while updating both ProviderSession gates to recognize it, preserving Chat Completions wire semantics and custom-endpoint routing.
User-approved decision (2026-08-17) is to preserve Chat Completions compatibility now with `openai-chat:` and defer deliberate Responses migration to a separate story (upbeat-illadvised-springtail).
